title: Publish isolation coverage in the krn/gate check-run text
body:
Outcome: the Jenkins krn/gate check-run text states the isolation file count and skip count for the exact head, from trusted code.
Evidence (t-mzsecc0, PR #164): the guest merges gate stdout and stderr and logs only the first 256 KiB (infra/ci/internal/executor/model.go:21 LogLimit, guest.go summaryStream); evidence/main_linux.go:188 publishes the tail of that, so no node-side line reaches GitHub. The decoded KRN_TEST_SUMMARY_JSON is in receipt.json but not in summary.txt.
Shape: trusted Go formats one line from the decoded Summary (files, tests, skipped) into summary.txt ahead of the tails; deploy needs merge, install and a library_sha/binary bump. Never add a JSON field from node before Go accepts it (DisallowUnknownFields).
